roadmap.title: Site roadmap
roadmap.p1: Foundations: profile (language, separators, keyboard), formulas in your Excel language, progress export.
roadmap.p2: Monkeytype-style Sprint mode, Tab completion coach, symbol analysis, argument tooltip.
roadmap.p3: Teaching: debugger, explanations, error diagnosis, spaced repetition, lessons.
roadmap.p4: Community: exercise editor, new languages and keyboards, leaderboard.
footer.shortcuts: Shortcuts are those of English Excel for Windows, typed on a US QWERTY keyboard. For another setup, those that may differ carry the “not verified for your setup” badge. A few shortcuts reserved by the browser (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+PageDown…) are practised as multiple choice.
step.nav.title: Navigation and entry
step.nav.intro: The moves, selections and entries you make hundreds of times per case: Ctrl+arrows, F2, Ctrl+D, Alt+=…
step.fmt.title: Formatting and ribbon
step.fmt.intro: Number formats, borders, colours and ribbon sequences (Alt H H, Alt H B A…). Release Alt before typing the letters, as in Excel.
step.typing.title: Formula typing
step.typing.intro: Copy formulas character by character: parentheses, separators, quotation marks, $ and function names. With Tab on, you also practise function completion as in Excel.
step.formula.title: Writing formulas
step.formula.intro: Write the requested formula in the formula bar, on the sample sheet. Tab completes the function name and you can leave out the closing parentheses, as in Excel.
step.dyn.title: Dynamic arrays (hard)
step.dyn.intro: MAKEARRAY, SCAN, REDUCE, MAP, BYROW, BYCOL, TOCOL, WRAPROWS, EXPAND… Your formula is actually calculated: any solution that gives the expected result is accepted.
step.regex.title: Regex
step.regex.intro: Regular expressions for REGEXTEST, REGEXEXTRACT and REGEXREPLACE: a course, a live tester, pattern exercises and calculated REGEX formulas.
step.vba.title: VBA
step.vba.intro: Copy common macros as fast as you can. Indentation is added for you and case does not matter: the VBA editor fixes it.
step.case.title: Timed mini-cases
step.case.intro: Copy the dataset, paste it into A1 in your Excel, solve the question and type the result here. This is the closest exercise to a real competition case.

landing.meta.title: XL Sprint — type Excel formulas faster
landing.meta.description: Speed training for Excel esports: Sprint mode, Tab completion coach, slow-symbol analysis, in your Excel language.
landing.hero.title: Type Excel formulas faster.
landing.hero.sub: Monkeytype-style training, built for Excel: formula typing sprints, a coach that teaches you Tab completion and an analysis of your slowest symbols. In your Excel’s language, with its separators.
landing.hero.visual: Animation: a formula typed with Tab completion and the argument tooltip
landing.demo.title: Try it now
landing.demo.sub: Three formulas, on your keyboard. The timer starts on the first key, Tab completes functions.
landing.demo.kbd: The demo needs a physical keyboard.
landing.features.title: More than a speed test
landing.features.sub: XL Sprint measures you, then teaches you to go faster.
landing.f.sprint.d: Tests of 15 to 120 seconds or 5 to 25 formulas, back to back. Net speed, accuracy, consistency and a ghost of your best.
landing.f.coach.d: It works out the minimum keystrokes for each formula and shows where Tab would save you time.
landing.f.symbols.d: Parentheses, quotes, separators, $: every key is timed and shown on your keyboard, QWERTY or AZERTY.
landing.f.tooltip.d: As in Excel: the function signature with the current argument in bold.
landing.f.engine.d: Dynamic arrays, LET, LAMBDA, REGEX: any formula that gives the right result is accepted.
landing.f.universal.d: Function names in English or French, “,” or “;” separator, QWERTY or AZERTY keyboard. More languages will follow.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.1.d: Function language, separators, keyboard, version: one minute on first launch.
landing.how.2.d: Short sprints, every day. Missed formulas come back more often.
landing.how.3.d: Bests, curves and a map of your slow keys, saved in your browser.
landing.pricing.title: Simple pricing
landing.pricing.sub: Sprint is free, forever. The full path takes you to competition level.

landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.account.a: No. Your progress stays in your browser; you can export it to a file.
landing.faq.offline.a: Yes: the app also comes as a single HTML file that opens without a connection.
landing.faq.french.q: My Excel is in French, with semicolons.
landing.faq.french.a: Choose “functions in French” and “;”: formulas are shown and typed as in your Excel. Translations not yet confirmed are flagged.
landing.faq.mac.a: Shortcuts are the Windows ones for now; a Mac version is planned.
landing.faq.data.q: What do you do with my data?
landing.faq.data.a: Nothing: no data is sent, everything stays on your device.
